item.title: Why DMARC's new "NP" tag can fail with DNSSEC
item.description:
📝 Its purpose is to specify the policy that receivers should apply when the sender domain is a non-existent subdomain of the domain where the DMARC record is published. item.description:
📝 Upgrading the flying umbrella with autonomous capabilities John Tse of I Build Stuff creates an autonomous flying umbrella that follows and shields the users from rain and sunlight. This allows the flying umbrella to stay compact when carried and stable when flying. Inside the autonomous flying umbrella is a collection of electronics that make it work.
